gripOrHq.title: Fubar
gripOrHq.rulesText: [1]: Break a subroutine of the type chosen for Fubar. [2]: +1 strength. [0]: Choose whether Fubar breaks code gates, sentries, or walls. Use this ability only once. Whenever you break an ice subroutine with Fubar, lose [1] from a stealth card.

gripOrHq.title: Disintegrator
gripOrHq.rulesText: [2]: Derez a piece of ice and end your run. Use this ability only when you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice and have successfully passed it.

gripOrHq.title: Viral Pipeline
gripOrHq.rulesText: After each successful run on Archives, HQ, or R&D, put a Socket counter in that data fort. Socket counter from Archives, Socket counter from HQ, and Socket counter from R&D: Give the Corp a Pipe counter. Each Pipe counter causes the Corp to forgo an action at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

gripOrHq.title: Highlighter
gripOrHq.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Highlighter counter. Each Highlighter counter after the first allows you to access an additional card from R&D whenever you access cards from R&D. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

scoreArea.title: Marked Accounts
scoreArea.rulesText: When Runner accesses Marked Accounts, give Runner a tag, even if it is not installed. If Marked Accounts is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

scoreArea.title: Viral Breeding Ground
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Breeding Ground, trash all cards installed in or on the fort Breeding Ground was installed in. When Runner accesses Breeding Ground, choose up to two programs for each advancement counter on Breeding Ground; Runner brings those programs into his or her hand.

scoreArea.title: Viral Breeding Ground
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Breeding Ground, trash all cards installed in or on the fort Breeding Ground was installed in. When Runner accesses Breeding Ground, choose up to two programs for each advancement counter on Breeding Ground; Runner brings those programs into his or her hand.

rig.title: Black Widow
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break sentry subroutine. [2]: +1 strength. Choose an installed piece of ice when you install Black Widow. Black Widow gets +5 strength during each encounter with that piece of ice.

rig.title: Highlighter
rig.rulesText: After each successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Highlighter counter. Each Highlighter counter after the first allows you to access an additional card from R&D whenever you access cards from R&D. The Corp may remove all Virus counters at any time, but must then forgo its next three actions.

rig.title: Cortical Stimulators
rig.rulesText: Prevents 1 Net or brain damage each turn.

rig.title: Karl de Veres, Corporate Stooge
rig.rulesText: Gain [1] after each successful run. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

ice.title: Dog Pile
ice.rulesText: *Do 1 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Dog Pile. *End the run. Dog Pile has +1 strength for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside it.

ice.title: Bug Zapper
ice.rulesText: *Do 2 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Bug Zapper. *End the run.

ice.title: Credit Blocks
ice.rulesText: *End the run. When you rez Credit Blocks, you may pay [1], above the rez cost, to make it a wall instead of a sentry.

root.title: Rasmin Bridger
root.rulesText: After Runner passes each piece of ice on this fort, Runner must pay [1] or end the run.

root.title: Pattel Antibody
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Pattel Antibody, you may pay [3] to put a Pattel counter on all installed icebreakers, even if Pattel Antibody is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses Pattel Antibody from the Archives. Each Pattel counter on an icebreaker reduces its strength by 1. If Pattel Antibody is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

root.title: Bel-Digmo Antibody
root.rulesText: Shuffle Bel-Digmo Antibody into R&D when it is rezzed. When Runner accesses Bel-Digmo Antibody from R&D, do 1 Net damage, and Runner must show it to you.

root.title: Stereogram Antibody
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Stereogram Antibody from the Archives, do 1 Net damage and shuffle Stereogram Antibody into R&D.

root.title: Stereogram Antibody
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Stereogram Antibody from the Archives, do 1 Net damage and shuffle Stereogram Antibody into R&D.
